bank_assessment.novelty: Low: all 16 use the same two-clause agreement template, eight are clause-order reversals of the other eight, and the nouns and verbs supply mostly cosmetic variety.
bank_assessment.repeated_exposure_effect: Standalone items merit level 2 under the stated rubric. After the first few, the learner can reuse the same identify-head-subject and ignore-near-phrase rule; reversed pairs also cue previously seen answers. Later items are likely experienced as level 1 recognition rather than independent level 2 application.
bank_assessment.choice_equivalence: No item has two answer choices with equivalent ordered verb forms; each letter expresses a distinct combination. Each item has exactly one defensible answer.
bank_assessment.ambiguity: No wording ambiguity changes the agreement answer. Some reciprocal near-phrases and definite references are stylistically forced.
